race.comment: KOTAHITANGA (10) bumped into a dominant winner on debut here but did well holding onto second after showing speed. He was in the market there and should improve now, with any luck from the wide gate he'll go one better. Wary of the well bred CAB FRANC (8) who debuted over 1100m at Caulfield Heath and just found them too sharp. He looks a sharp improve up in trip and will take holding out. STONEFLIGHT (13) resumes having been well backed on debut at Geelong in April. Didn't fire there but is worth keeping an eye on this time around. VIA THERESA (14) didn't fire a shot on debut before heading straight for a spell. Recent jumpout was encouraging and appears to have come back well. Jockey/trainer combo also not one to ever be taken lightly.
